page.layout: One column of names in the centre, divided by horizontal rules into groups. Four notes in the left margin, year numbers in the right margin beside the groups. Page number 48 at the top right. No running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: Johan Wifering. Sententia altera & tertia ibidem lata.
Ioachim Alting. In sententia II de quinta censuum quod erat scriptu, id eodem vergente anno & sequente ab ordinibus gen. explanatum.
Herman Wiferinge. Civitas & ager inopino tnr-bine[?] perculsi.
Tammo Coenders. Emda armis infelicibus à Comite E N N O N E petita, magno toti’ regionis malo.

page.notes: The first line "Mello Coenders." carries a stray mark before the name in the scan, which I have not transcribed. "1600" in the right margin is set in old-style figures and is only partly clear; the reading is doubtful. "tnr-bine" in the left note is doubtful. The place name in the left note is printed in spaced capitals. The apostrophe after "toti" is as printed. Stains and show-through at the foot of the page are not transcribed.
